_comment: Config for gerber_gate — the deterministic gate for step 11 (Gerber Export). Read-only: it does NOT export (export_pcb / ship_design do that); it verifies the exported artifacts in the gerbers/ folder next to the .kicad_pcb — the required copper/mask/silk/edge layers, a drill file, the job file, and the pick-and-place. Paste layers are required only when the board actually has SMD pads (dynamic). The 'block export unless every prior gate passed' rule is enforced by pipeline_gate ordering (this is step 11). No gerbers yet => NOT EXPORTED (pending, not a failure). Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow step 11 (Gerber Export) + export_pcb output convention (gerbers/ subfolder).

gerber_layers._rule: Rule 1 — the required fab layer set must be present as .gbr files: copper, solder mask, silkscreen, edge cuts (+ paste when the board has SMD).

drill_file._rule: Rule 1 — at least one Excellon drill file (.drl) must be present.

gerber_job._rule: Rule 4 — the .gbrjob job file (tells the fab the layer stackup/format) should be present.

place_file._rule: Rule 2 — the pick-and-place file (-pos.csv) should be present when assembling.

verdict.verified: GERBERS VERIFIED — {found}/{req} layers + drill present, ready to ship
verdict.not_exported: NOT EXPORTED — no gerbers/ folder yet; run export_pcb or ship_design
